WDSH-001.scenario: Verify that the Dashboard opens for the signed-in admin
WDSH-001.preconditions: Admin is signed in to the console. Note: the Dashboard is still under development, so a failure here is pending development, not a defect.
steps: Click Dashboard in the left menu.
Wait for the page to finish loading.
Check the page address and the Dashboard menu item.
WDSH-001.expected: The Dashboard page opens (address contains 'dashboard') or the Dashboard menu item is shown as active and clickable.

WDSH-002.scenario: Verify that every live module in the left menu is enabled and clickable
WDSH-002.preconditions: Admin is signed in and on the Dashboard. Dashboard is still under development.
steps: Wait for the left menu to appear (up to 15 seconds).
For each live menu item, check that it is visible and not dimmed or disabled.
WDSH-002.test_data: Live items: Dashboard, Beneficiary List, Transfers, Audit Trail, User Management, Change password, Sign out
WDSH-002.expected: Each live menu item is visible and enabled.

WDSH-003.scenario: Check that modules not yet released are dimmed and cannot be clicked
WDSH-003.preconditions: Admin is signed in and on the Dashboard. Dashboard is still under development.
steps: Look at each not-yet-released item in the left menu.
Check whether it is visible and enabled.
WDSH-003.test_data: Not-live items: Create Transfer, Approvals, Master Escrow, Escrow Transfer, Escrow Deposit, Virtual ID, Deposits, QR Settlements
WDSH-003.expected: Each of these items is hidden or shown as disabled (cannot be clicked).

WDSH-004.scenario: Check that typing the web address of a not-yet-released module does not open it
WDSH-004.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Dashboard is still under development.
steps: In the browser address bar, enter the console address followed by the module path.
Check the page text and the final address.
WDSH-004.expected: The module does not open: the page shows a message such as 'not found', 'forbidden', 'no access', 'access denied' or 'cannot open', or the user is redirected to another page.

WDSH-005.scenario: Verify that money amounts on the Dashboard are shown in Indian Rupees
WDSH-005.preconditions: Admin is signed in. Amounts must be visible on the Dashboard (otherwise the test is skipped). Dashboard is still under development.
steps: Click Dashboard in the left menu and wait for it to load.
Look at the amounts shown on the page.
WDSH-005.expected: Amounts are shown with the ₹ symbol or 'INR'.
